title.en: Architecture tree sync after the 3C refactor: gameplay-3c tree, Cinemachine camera and input relocation
title.zh: 3C 重构后的架构树同步：新建 gameplay-3c 树、Cinemachine 镜头与输入迁移

intent.en: Commit 20034a1 moved camera/character/control code into Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C and swapped the hand-rolled camera for Cinemachine 2.10.3; commit 3e9431e then fixed map collision, hit feedback and side-wall friction. The module tree still pointed at the deleted GameBase/InputManager paths (12 source-missing modules) and had no representation for the 3C layer at all, so the diagram no longer matched the code.
intent.zh: 提交 20034a1 把相机/角色/控制代码迁进 Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C 并用 Cinemachine 2.10.3 替换手写相机；提交 3e9431e 又修了地图碰撞、受击反馈与侧墙摩擦。模块树仍指向已删除的 GameBase/InputManager 路径（12 个 source-missing 模块），且完全没有 3C 层的表达，图谱与代码已经对不上。

acceptance: 新增顶层 project-chaos.gameplay-3c（camera/character/control 三支），与 Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C 目录一一对应
framework.input 与 framework.input-icons 已整棵迁到 gameplay-3c.control，uid 保持不变，全项目 deps.to 已重写
12 个 input/input-icons 模块的 source 指向 Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C/Control/InputManager/ 且行段按实测 1164/284 行重算，4 条 file API 同步更新
新增 InputManager.Gameplay.cs 的 gameplay-scope 叶子与 shortcuts 叶子，覆盖此前无模块覆盖的 3C/Control 代码
新增 editor-tools.camera-tool（verification / runtime-probes）覆盖 Editor/CameraTool 4 个脚本
根 / framework / gameplay-3c / camera / character / control / input / editor-tools / camera-tool 各层渲染数据已写入
note:
3C 重构（20034a1 + 3e9431e）后的架构树对齐：迁入 Cinemachine 镜头/角色/控制三层，并把 input 与 input-icons 从 framework 搬到 gameplay-3c.control；同时补建 Editor/CameraTool 覆盖。
3C 重构后对齐完成：新增 gameplay-3c 顶层树（camera/character/control），input 与 input-icons 整棵从 framework 迁入 gameplay-3c.control 并改指 3C/Control/InputManager/，补建 gameplay-scope 与 shortcuts，新增 editor-tools.camera-tool。validate 0 error / 20 warning。
